Package ro.ubb.map.retea.domain

Class Prietenie

java.lang.Object
ro.ubb.map.retea.domain.Entity<Tuple<Long,Long>>
ro.ubb.map.retea.domain.Prietenie
public class Prietenie extends Entity<Tuple<Long,Long>>
A friendship between two users. The id is the pair (smallerId, largerId), so the friendship 1-2 is identical to 2-1.

    • Prietenie

      public Prietenie(Long idUnu, Long idDoi, LocalDateTime data)
      Creates a normalized friendship (smaller id first). Null ids are kept as they are, so that the validator can reject them.
      Parameters:
      idUnu - the id of one user
      idDoi - the id of the other user
      data - the date the friendship started
